say: Devlog. Her feet used to slide.
The legs just swung on a timer, while the body glided along at a constant speed.
So instead of animating legs, I plant feet.
The walk follows clinical gait timing. Heel strike. Foot flat. Heel off. Toe off. Then the swing.
A planted foot is a fixed point on the ledge. The hips move on, and each leg is solved to reach its foot.
Turning used to spin her on the spot, and her feet skated nearly ten centimetres.
Now she steps round in three steps, and every foot lands where it's put.
Walking, turning, kicking, sitting down. Under a millimetre of slip.
